Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ's):
Q. What is the PCOS Mini test by Thyrocare?
Ans.
The PCOS Mini by Thyrocare is a diagnostic test package designed to evaluate hormonal imbalances and other health markers commonly associated with Polycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS).
Q. Who should consider taking the Thyrocare PCOS Mini test?
Ans.
This test is recommended for women experiencing symptoms such as irregular menstrual cycles, weight gain, acne, excessive hair growth, or difficulty in conceiving, which are commonly linked to PCOS.
Q. What tests are included in the Thyrocare PCOS Mini package?
Ans.
The package typically includes:
Luteinizing Hormone (LH)
Follicle Stimulating Hormone (FSH)
Prolactin
Testosterone
Thyroid Stimulating Hormone (TSH)
These tests provide a comprehensive analysis of hormonal health.
Q. Is fasting required before taking the Thyrocare PCOS Mini test?
Ans.
Yes, fasting for 8-10 hours is generally recommended for accurate results. You can drink water during the fasting period.
Q. How can I book the Thyrocare PCOS Mini test online?
Ans.
Booking the PCOS Mini test by Thyrocare is easy through our website. Choose the test, schedule a convenient time, and our home collection service will handle the rest.
Q. What is the cost of the Thyrocare PCOS Mini test?
Ans.
The cost of the PCOS Mini package by Thyrocare varies depending on your location and ongoing offers. Visit our website or contact us for updated pricing and discounts.
Q. How long does it take to get results for the Thyrocare PCOS Mini test?
Ans.
Test results are typically available within 24-48 hours and can be accessed online or delivered to your email for convenience.
Q. How does the Thyrocare PCOS Mini test help in diagnosing PCOS?
Ans.
This test measures key hormones like LH, FSH, and testosterone, which are often imbalanced in PCOS, helping diagnose the condition and guide effective treatment.
Q. Can the Thyrocare PCOS Mini test detect other health issues related to PCOS?
Ans.
Yes, this test can identify hormonal imbalances and thyroid issues, which are often associated with PCOS and can impact overall health.

Q: What is the Thyrocare PCOS Care Package?
Ans.
The PCOS Care Package is a comprehensive diagnostic and wellness panel specially designed for women experiencing symptoms or managing Polycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS). It includes hormonal tests, insulin resistance checks, and consultation support to assist with fertility, weight control, and hormonal balance.
Q: What tests are included in this package?
Ans.
The package typically includes:
Hormonal Panel: LH, FSH, Prolactin, AMH, Estradiol, Testosterone, DHEA-S
Thyroid Profile: TSH, T3, T4
Insulin & Glucose Levels: Fasting Insulin, Fasting Blood Sugar, HOMA-IR
Lipid Profile: Cholesterol, HDL, LDL, Triglycerides
Ultrasound Screening (at selected centers, where applicable)
These tests help assess menstrual health, ovulation, metabolic status, and risk factors related to PCOS.
Q: Who should opt for this package?
Ans.
This package is recommended for:
Women with irregular periods, acne, facial hair, or weight gain
Those trying to conceive
Individuals with a family history of PCOS
Women experiencing hormonal imbalances or insulin resistance
Q: Is fasting required for this test?
Ans.
Yes, fasting for 8–10 hours is recommended before the blood sample is collected to ensure accurate results for glucose and insulin-related parameters.
Q: How is the sample collected?

A certified Thyrocare technician will collect your sample from the comfort of your home. BookMyTest offers free home sample collection across India.
Q: When will I receive the test results?

Reports are typically shared within 24 to 48 hours via email, WhatsApp, and your BookMyTest dashboard.
Q: What is the cost of the PCOS Care Package?

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ's):
1. What is the PCOS Manage Package?
The
PCOS Manage Package
is a comprehensive diagnostic package that evaluates hormones and other important health markers associated with Polycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS). It helps assess hormonal balance and supports the diagnosis and management of PCOS.
2. Why is the PCOS Manage Package recommended?
The package is recommended to identify hormonal imbalances, evaluate insulin resistance, assess thyroid function, monitor metabolic health, and detect conditions commonly associated with PCOS, enabling timely medical management.
3. Who should consider the PCOS Manage Package?
The
PCOS Manage Package
is recommended for women experiencing irregular menstrual cycles, infertility, acne, excessive facial or body hair growth, hair loss, unexplained weight gain, pelvic discomfort, or symptoms suggestive of PCOS.
4. What health conditions can the PCOS Manage Package help assess?
The package helps assess PCOS, hormonal imbalance, insulin resistance, thyroid disorders, metabolic syndrome, high cholesterol, diabetes risk, and reproductive health concerns that may affect menstrual health and fertility.
5. What symptoms may indicate the need for a PCOS screening package?
Symptoms such as irregular or missed periods, acne, excessive facial or body hair, weight gain, thinning hair, difficulty conceiving, darkened skin patches, and persistent fatigue may indicate the need for PCOS screening.
6. Is fasting required for the PCOS Manage Package?
Some tests included in the
PCOS Manage Package
, particularly blood sugar, insulin, and lipid profile tests, may require fasting for 8 to 12 hours. Please follow the preparation instructions provided during booking.
7. How often should I undergo the PCOS Manage Package?
Women diagnosed with PCOS may benefit from regular monitoring every 6 to 12 months or as recommended by their healthcare provider. Individuals undergoing treatment may require testing at different intervals based on clinical advice.
8. Is home sample collection available for the PCOS Manage Package?
Yes. When you book the
PCOS Manage Package
through
BookMyTest
, trained phlebotomists collect your blood sample from your preferred location, ensuring a convenient and comfortable testing experience.
9. How will I receive my reports?
Your
PCOS Manage Package
reports are securely delivered online after laboratory analysis. You can download your reports and consult your gynecologist or endocrinologist for interpretation and treatment planning.
10. Why choose the PCOS Manage Package through BookMyTest?
Booking the
PCOS Manage Package
through
BookMyTest
gives you access to trusted diagnostic laboratories, professional home sample collection, accurate test results, secure online report delivery, affordable pricing, and a seamless booking experience. It is an effective way to monitor hormonal health, support early diagnosis of PCOS, and take proactive steps toward better reproductive and metabolic wellness.
